description: This file defines functions and server setup code for a fake XML-RPC test runner used in testing remote execution features within the TestLink project. It handles specific test case requests like 'sayPassed', 'sayBlocked', etc., and utilizes an external XML-RPC class.

classes.name: IXR_Server
classes.description: A class used to set up the XML-RPC server handling remote procedure calls.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Simulates execution of a test case based on provided arguments, returning a result status, notes, and timestamp.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the current server time in HH:MM:SS format.
